description.en: Electromagnetic switch for repeated load switching, typically motors, with control by a coil. Overload is handled by a separate relay.
description.es: Interruptor electromagnetico para maniobras repetidas de carga, normalmente motores, con control por bobina. La sobrecarga la gestiona un relé separado.

note.en: AC-3 for normal squirrel-cage motor starting and switching off at running speed; AC-4 for more severe duty
note.es: AC-3 para arranque normal de motor de jaula y paro en marcha; AC-4 para servicio mas severo
